notes.upstream: AI is ripping. Finally got around to clearing out some long-standing issues, formalize a grammar (though it's still wip), fix a bunch of corner cases, tedious issues, etc. I'm focusing on 2 things: 1. Performance -- across size of build (mainly for client-side/JS use case), size of output, and speed. All 3 have advanced significantly in this release, somewhat near capabilities of public frontier models. We'll revisit when the Reimann Hypothesis-solving generation of models come out. 2. Animations. I make a lot of [3b1b-type explainer videos](https://github.com/d2lang/d2/pull/2986) to understand things in my day-to-day work and the quality is tempermental. There's a 3b1b library for their animations but it didn't work well for me and I've removed it from my prompts. I'm more motivated to do well here for my own use case, so I want to make animations in D2 really nice throughout the 0.10 series of releases. I plan to cut a 1.0 soon finally. There'll be more one-time breaking changes like consolidating casing/hyphenation (e.g. `sequence_diagram` to `sequence-diagram`).
